id: title:Gilbert09:drop the server cursor seek fallback for seekable tables

review.posthog_relevance: Changes PostgreSQL warehouse ingestion recovery behavior: when a read replica recovery conflict occurs and no xmin bounds exist, the ingestion no longer silently falls back to offset chunking but raises an error, potentially changing retry behavior.
review.reason: The chunk implements a substantive, bounded correctness and reliability improvement. P1.F2.H1 removes a fallback behavior that could lead to inconsistent ingestion or silent failures during PostgreSQL read replica recovery conflicts, replacing it with a clear error. P1.F2.H2 and P1.F2.H4 provide supporting implementation and test coverage, including assertions that statement timeo.
review.uncertainty: The exact production impact of removing the fallback depends on the specific recovery scenarios and database configurations not fully described; the benefit is demonstrated by the removal of the fallback and addition of tests, but not by observed production metrics.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No abstention.

observations.behavior: Removes fallback to offset chunking when xmin_bounds is None; raises an error instead. P1.F1.H1.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes PostgreSQL warehouse ingestion recovery behavior: when a read replica recovery conflict occurs and no xmin bounds exist, the ingestion no longer silently falls back to offset chunking but raises an error, potentially changing retry behavior.

observations.behavior: Adds page_error parameter to PageCursor and _read_ids; injects page_error into cursor mock. P1.F2.H2, P1.F2.H3.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows tests to simulate cursor cancellation and propagate that error to the ingestion path, supporting the recovery behavior change.

observations.behavior: P1.F2.H4 adds a test asserting that statement timeout on a xmin reread is non-retryable. P1.F2.H4.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds test coverage for warehouse ingestion recovery, asserting that statement timeouts during xmin rereads are treated as non-retryable errors.
